headline: Peña Returns
caption:
Julianna Peña is back, but on the wrestling mats, the same night Kayla Harrison fights Amanda Nunes 🤼‍♀️
Can Peña win, yes or no? 👇

The former UFC bantamweight champ faces Diana Avsaragova in a freestyle wrestling match at RAF Abu Dhabi on Nov. 14, her first action since losing the belt to Harrison. Harrison vs. Nunes co-headlines UFC 334 at MSG that night. MMA news.

Who wins on the mats?
